scope: Complete 15-path profile-I/O executor overlay; no runtime qualification

resolved_findings: Initial rating preflight cancellation now resolves only the live exact pending command before RatingRead/Publishing creation; terminal or expiry-notified slots cannot grant Cancel success.
Recursive source access tracks owned depth across moves and exceptions; observed nested writes refuse before effects, and outside callbacks cannot run beneath a remaining source-gate level.

source_conclusions: Source-gate then version-mutex order remains consistent. Network continuations use bounded atomic revisions and one-shot permits without filesystem access, gate acquisition, or future waits.
Worker jobs own immutable inputs, retained same-OFD lease, and shared job/mailbox state; actor callbacks remain owner-thread slots. Unbind serializes posting before owner destruction.

Permits remain single-use; executing permits retain worker-held authority until acknowledgment. Queued, running, ready and result storage remain bounded; close revokes network authority before external join.
Current request, peer/socket, token, router/database, source and deadline gates remain at packet effects. Cancellation, stale completion and readmission do not manufacture successful publication.

Focused new controls exercise held real gate cancellation, fresh rating read, source changes, permit reclamation, and nested-observer refusal. Existing core Executor and prior owned-service tests remain unchanged.
limitations: Review is source-only; no build, native/Java test, endpoint, performance measurement, or kernel-stall experiment was executed.
External full join may wait for an uninterruptible filesystem syscall or an already-entered source gate; held-permit tests do not prove kernel-stall latency.
